scope: Data-blind RR-window-convolved forward model for frozen DESI DR1 LRGxELG templates
status: PASS; window correction modest but nonzero

theory.standard_odd: linked Bonvin relativistic + leading wide-angle ell=1 benchmark
theory.standard_even: linear Kaiser LRGxELG ell=0,2,4 with fixed b_LRG=2.0, b_ELG=1.3 and per-bin growth f

interpretation: PASS. The pre-window recomputation reproduces the frozen templates essentially exactly. RR-window convolution leaves the wake and linked odd-standard shapes nearly unchanged. Linear Kaiser even-to-odd leakage is nonzero at about 7.4% of the physical odd-standard RMS and should be included in the final nuisance template, but the window correction is modest rather than dominant.
